newsitem.title: USA: Kansas City Southern declares stock split.
newsitem.headline: Kansas City Southern declares stock split.

text.p: Kansas City Southern Industries Inc said Tuesday it declared a three-for-one stock split and raised its dividend by 20 percent.
The stock split will be in the form of a stock dividend payable September 16 to stockholders of record as of August 25.
The quarterly dividend was raised to $0.12 a share from $0.10 on a pre-split basis, and is also payable on September 16 to shareholders of recond as of August 25.
Kansas City Southern said the split and dividend increase are in response to strength in two of its business segment -- Fiancial Asset Management and Transportation.

Kansas City Southern Railway has made acquisitions both in the United States and in Mexico. In the Financial Asset segment, the Janus and Berger mutual funds have grown to $69.7 billion from $49.9 billion since the beginning of the year, the company said.
Kansas City Southern as of June 30 had about 35.73 million shares outstanding, and after the split will have some 107.18 million.
